$schema: Cross-language X3DH + Double-Ratchet test vectors. See README.md for contract.

cases.name: x3dh_basic
cases.description: Full X3DH session establishment from pinned 32-byte X25519 raw private keys. Tests cross-language agreement on (a) X25519 ECDH (RFC 7748 clamping is library-internal), (b) HKDF-SHA256 root-key derivation over concat(DH1||DH2||DH3||DH4), (c) HKDF-SHA256 chain-key derivation with side-specific info strings.

cases.name: ratchet_step_basic
cases.description: Single Double-Ratchet step. Inputs: 32-byte chain key. Outputs: messageKey = HMAC-SHA256(chainKey, 0x01); nextChainKey = HMAC-SHA256(chainKey, 0x02). Each language verifies it produces these exact bytes.

cases.name: ratchet_step_three_iterations
cases.description: Three sequential Double-Ratchet steps. Validates the full chain key advancement sequence. Each iteration: msgKey_n = HMAC(chainKey_n, 0x01); chainKey_{n+1} = HMAC(chainKey_n, 0x02). Both keys per step published in expected/.

cases.name: kdf_rk_basic
cases.description: Signal Double-Ratchet KDF_RK step (§5.2). Inputs: 32-byte root key (RK), 32-byte DH output. Computation: HKDF-SHA256(salt=RK, ikm=DH, info=UTF8('aether-ratchet-rk-v1'), L=64); first 32 bytes = new root key, second 32 bytes = new chain key. Each language's high-level Signal service must produce these exact bytes.
